llm.summary: This skill is a local-only note board app whose storage, file handling, and export behavior match its stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: The app uses browser localStorage, IndexedDB, clipboard paste/copy events, file picker/drag-drop, and local downloads, all of which are proportionate to a local note and document organizer.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No executable install script is present; the primary deliverable is an HTML file opened directly in a browser, with optional packaging guidance for users who explicitly want a skill package.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The invocation wording is somewhat broad, including generic note, clipboard, archive, and skill-packaging requests, but the actual instructions and artifact remain focused on this specific local note-board app.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: User text, images, and uploaded file blobs persist in browser storage until the user deletes or clears them; this is disclosed and purpose-aligned, with no evidence of network upload or hidden privilege use.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill provides a single-file front-end app for collecting text, managing pasted images and uploaded documents, organizing folders, and exporting notes to .docx; these capabilities match the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this if you want a local browser-based note and file collection board. Be aware that pasted text, images, and uploaded files are saved persistently in your browser storage on that device; clear the app data, trash, drafts, and folders when you no longer want that local data retained.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad description at line 3 maps mostly to the app's intended note-board, clipboard, archive, and export use cases; it is a routing-quality concern rather than evidence of hidden or unsafe behavior.
[SQP-1] expected: The broad 'when to use' list at lines 14-17 could be narrowed, but the runtime artifact stays within disclosed local note collection, file organization, and optional packaging workflows.
